title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I gave three talaqs to my first wife on the same day and same time. 2053 views Q. Me and my wife are married for 3 years now we had a arguement and she has been living with her parents for about 4 months, And we have a child together, a baby boy, now she wants me to divorce her but she is not understanding and her parents have helping her get that divorce but i still love her and i have said sorry to her for my mistakes which i have done, but she still does not want to come back. Can she get a divorce without my consent and without me agreeing. 2287 views Q. 1231 views Q. In a fit of anger, i said to my wife "I am setting you free (relieving) you from my life" I said it three times. (In Urdu: "Maine tumhein apni zindagi se azaad kiya") I can't say for sure whether my intention was to give Talaaq or not. My wife was bit sleepy but she heard these words clearly. I would like to know if our marriage is valid. I called up her mother and i told her that i have said these things to my wife. She said that our marriage is valid. Please guide me and let me know if our marriage is valid. 3141 views Q. Woman married 5 years back after that lady left husband without talak can the woman marry again without divorce her husband? 2306 views Q. I was married on Feb 16,2003 and came back to Arab for job to-date I did not go to India due to my job and passport problem. Allah bless us baby boy on Dec 20,2003. In Feb 2004, I lost the job and my inlaws started blaming me that I am married in Saudia. I sent to my wife money several times till June 2004 but after that she refused to take money, the reason was wrong concept of my marriage. After that she left the town and settled in Delhi without my consent and started Diploma in Beauty Parlor course. She came back again to home town in her mother home in July 2005, then I sent her money but she again refused. In Dec 2005, she left to Pakistan without my consent and came back after several months. In July 2006 she called me very nicely I pardoned her and we started talking till Aug 26, 2006. On Sept 13, 2006, She left to Africa along with my three old son without informing me. Her African uncle promised me to send wife/ son to me. She talked nicely from Nov 7 to Dec 2 2006. And suddenly she filed a in Jamiat Ulema Africa for Khula. The main point the wife raised that I am not in touch with her for three years and neither send her money. (Is her maintenace claim valid if she is running here/there in different countries without informing me). They are denying any conversation between Nov 7,2006 to Dec 24,2006 by saying that the voice can be developed on computer in fraud way. The last money I sent her on Aug 6, 2005 because after that she refused to accept. She want to keep son with her. My question is that on this ground our nikah will remain valid or it will finish. I want my wife and son with me as per Quran/ Sunnah. 1954 views Q. Almost three months back my self and my wife we were staying alone in Bahrian just before ramadan we both had a big fight and that time she was in her monthly cycle infact the matter was out of hands and we beat each other and in anger she first gave Talaq to me by taking Allah as Gawah to which i have called her parents in India and inform the same and called my family as well and was talking to them during that time as well she was still shouting at me and using bad language and that time I was too at the highest level of my anger and really out of my mind which I never encountered in my life till date. While I was still on phone talking to my mummy and Bahbi and she abusing me and during that time also i was out of control and immense anger have said that I take you (bhabi) as gawah and divorce her (thrice) which I even doesn't recollect that have given once or thrice and my bhabi says that I said it thrice. After 3 days she went to India and since then she is staying at her house and not in my house and both of us are not in physical contact since then but we talk once in a while. but since that day have not talked abt divorce at all nor she remembers the incident as she has not inform her parents about it as well. My question to you sir is does my Talaq counts or not under this conditions. as I am confused have ref to the Sahi Bukhari Sahrif and in that it is clear mentioned that under these circumstance (she in her Monthly Cycle) doesn?t count. even if I gave her once or thousand times. And secondly if your really out of our mind and pronounced divorce thrice does it counts. Can you please guide me. 2168 views Q. My wife had been told by some one that if husband and wife does not talk each other and if expenses is not sent is it automatically talaq and if husband is willing to talk to her but because she purposely does not pickup the phone in this case it is one sided avoid. I hope this does not occur as talaq. 2394 views Q. Talaq 1876 views Q. I have been seperated from my husband since jan/2010 and have filed for Khulla on jun/19/2010. i will get my Khulla/divorce certificate in one week. i did not have any contact with him during the time of seperation. i have been staying with my parents since jan/2010, and my only activity has been going to work and coming straight home. my question is, do i still have to attend the iddat period from when i get the certificate? 2135 views Q. In the first night I come to know that my wife had physical relation with anyone and she is not seemed ashamed for that.she was somewhat mentally abnormal also she lacks the qualities to be a faithful and good wife.Beside this I was not physically satisfied with her, but she was satisfied with me. Are these grounds are well enough to give her divorce? 2331 views Q. I want to ask my husband has the habit if telling in anger mostly go away i am fed up of u he has told many times but he cares me alot adn he is very loving but i have heardx even if u say like this it would constitute talaaq if u have intention, when i asked him after someyears what was his intention he doesn't answer what should i do. I am affected very badly by this rule how will i come to know weather my relationship with him is halaal or not? He used to say like this even for silly matters when he was angry it was his habit. 6274 views Q. Most humbly and requestfully I beg you to ask that; I got married at 4th of august 2010 without the involvement of guardian with a muslim girl. We too are adult; I have a Nikahnama from Madarsa. After 20 days her parents came at my place in mumbai and biforcely they approached my begum in my absence and came at their place with her. So my question are...... 1. Can her family is elidgible to take Khula withot my presence? 2. Without Khula , is she elidgible to get married? 3. I have no contact with her; Am i elidgible to take legal actions with her family, if yes then how? 1591 views Q. Talaq 2433 views Q. I want to know about the situation, once on sms my husband told me that his parents wants him to get marry, i asked him if he want to marry someone else then first divorce me, he replyed me with sms that i divorce u. I want to know is this divorce valid as i read some where as written divorce without intention doesnt occur i am not sure he wrote that with intention or without intention as he replyed me within few second i am not sure he thought before writing or not. 3786 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 15345 Country: United Kingdom Title: salam me and my husband have been married for 11 years and due to not being educated on islam we both were unaware of the procedure, as well as my husband being unaware of the quranic procedures regarding talaq he had been suffering from depression due to a number of reasons.Although we had disagreements in our marriage he never said divorce at all but the situation got out of hand and family got involved he said to me in english i dont want to be with you no more a member of my family forcefully said to him thats not the right way you have to say talaq three times and he said it three times in pressure he regrets what he did as he was already in a bad state of mind but he can take oath that he was unaware of the actual procedure he said he didnt want to be with me himself and then only repeated talaq 3 times together because he was told to do so. we want to reconcile both of us and want an approval.the sharia council in england have said it is classed as one please can you give us your opinion.this is an urgent matter as my iddat will be ending in a week please can you let me know as soon as possible jazakhallah Question: salam me and my husband have been married for 11 years and due to not being educated on islam we both were unaware of the procedure, as well as my husband being is classed as one please can you give us your opinion.this is an urgent matter as my iddat will be ending in a week please can you let me know as soon as possible jazakhallah Answer ID: 15345 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1421/280/TL=1430) If your husband gave you three talaqs though unknowingly, the three talaq took place and you were divorced with mughallzah bayinah and became haram for him. There is no way to rejoin by nikah without halalah . فان طلقھا فلا تحل لہ من بعد حتی تنکح زوجاً غیرہ As far as the decision of Shariah Council England is concerned, we cannot comment until we have all details. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
